title.zh: 行商舰队：范格利集团：最后提议
title.en: Caravan Fleet: The Vengralian Trium: Last Call

excerpt.zh: 你真的打算就这么让一生只会出现一次的机会白白溜走吗？
excerpt.en: Are you ready to seize this once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, before it's gone forever?

title.zh: 行商舰队：范格利集团：最后提议
title.en: Caravan Fleet: The Vengralian Trium: Last Call

texts.zh: 你真的打算就这么让一生只会出现一次的机会白白溜走吗？
texts.en: Are you ready to seize this once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, before it's gone forever?

texts.zh: 我们虽然很快就会分别，但是你可以永远持有我们的完美产品。
texts.en: We must soon part, but you can keep our excellent products with you forever.

texts.zh: 你要是不做这笔买卖那可就大错特错了。你再好好动脑子想想。
texts.en: You understood that you would be a fool to pass up this deal. You can now make good on that wisdom.

texts.zh: 亲爱的顾客，或者我应该说朋友？我们正准备离开你们的领地。请问您是否有兴趣再最后一次看看我们的产品呢？当然不会是真正的最后一次，我们以后也会来的。
texts.en: Dear customers - or dare we say friends? - we are departing your territories. May we interest you in our wares, one last time? Until next time, that is.

texts.zh: 这可是最后机会了，专门为你量身打造的订单！你肯定会感兴趣的！
texts.en: Last chance to strike this deal, tailored to your needs! You don't want to miss it!

responses.zh: 很高兴和你做生意。记住了：有梦想就一定要实现它！
responses.en: Pleasure doing business with you. And remember: don't dream it, be it!
